paraphrase: Silently, silently, words are forgotten; clearly, clearly it appears before you; when you mirror it, it is vast; where you embody it, it is spiritually alive; the numinous shines alone, and within the shining there is wonder.

original.text: 默默忘言。 昭昭現前。 鑒時廓爾。 體處靈然

paraphrase: If within illumination silence is lost, aggression appears; if within silence illumination is lost, all becomes murky superfluous dharma; when silence and illumination are complete, the lotus opens and the dreamer awakes, the hundred streams flow to the sea.

original.text: 照中失默。 便見侵凌。 證明問答。 相應恰恰。 默中失照。 渾成剩法
